title: Colony and Echo
author: Marguerite Brightwater
blurb: Oscar Villalobos, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
